teacher_role: Frozen probabilities on sampled training-text prefixes only
plan_revision: Width-320 CE became nonfinite at peak LR 0.001 and 0.0007; at 0.0003 and 0.0001 its loss collapsed to near-uniform predictions. Width-320 CE attempts were stopped or failed, so no width-320 distillation treatment was run and no paired width-320 benefit is claimed. All attempts remain in the search cost.
selection_rule: Compare paired validation BPB at equal training targets and independent CPU FP32 inference time. The test split is not evaluated for student selection.
cost_accounting: Report the student training and search cost in addition to all teacher-component training costs.
